attempts.summary: Built and validated a three-member etcd 3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (installed from GitHub binary release since no RHEL 9 package existed), loaded it with 5 application keys under /app/*, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, ran `member remove` from the surviving quorum, and irrecoverably wiped /var/lib/etcd on node3). Replaced it with a fresh member on node3 using `member add` + ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, which joined and fully synced all keys. Final cluster: 3 started members with matching raft term/index and all 5 keys present on every endpoint. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot IDs and healthy-service/data proof on all 3 nodes, restarted each node one at a time via native reboot (never more than one down simultaneously), confirmed changed boot IDs on all three, and verified full cluster health, membership, and data integrity after each restart.
